coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Strong lead. Decree D/2020/216/PRG of 26 Aug 2020 and 4 arrêtés (A/2544 agent cards, A/2546 operating authorisation, A/2547 equipment and uniforms) govern private security. A 2022 decree set up the regulator ORASPC, which issues, renews and withdraws agent cards. The joint arrêté A/2025/1410/MSPC/MEF/SGG on regulation fees was under dialogue with employers (CGE-GUI) in March 2026. About 460 firms and about 30,000 agents were counted in 2020. ORASPC planned an online platform for firms to submit data (2023); whether it is operational is unconfirmed. Cleaning and manpower agencies not screened.

coverage.found: Local-content rules are scattered (mining code, petroleum code, 2019 decree). Related to K01 and K10 (quarries rejected); nothing new beyond K01.

Sanctions include closure and fines.

The OGP also ran a national census of advertising supports (Dec 2025). Card price and legal basis not stated. Small niche.

coverage.category: 34. Gambling, lottery and betting retailers (LONAGUI)
coverage.found: Presidential decree of 13 May 2022 gave LONAGUI a monopoly on lotteries, games and sports betting; operators had 3 months to comply and LONAGUI took over about 1,500 of 5,400 declared sellers. The state operator controls the whole flow, so there is no obvious third-party software need.

coverage.category: 35. Road transport documents: digital registration, transport authorisations, technical inspection (trucks and moto-taxis)
coverage.found: Since May 2021 the transport ministry and DSD Guinée issue digital registration cards and secured transport authorisations. A 31 Aug 2024 deadline to replace old licences and registration cards, requested to move to December, was met with a continued-renewal decision. Moto-taxi arrêté of 2016 requires a transport card per driver. Overlaps with group A category 18, so only noted.

coverage.category: 36. Artisanal and small-scale mining (EMAPE) formalisation and financing
coverage.found: National guide for formalisation and financing of EMAPE delivered 1 July 2026 (PlanetGold); national financial-inclusion strategy for artisanal miners validated 30 June 2026; ban on heavy machinery at artisanal gold sites (March 2026); dedicated artisanal corridors, control teams and fee schedule announced. Related to K04 but a different buyer group (artisanal miners and their groups).
